blog_posts.title: Mastering Core Web Vitals: A Full-Stack Engineer’s Playbook
blog_posts.excerpt: Why INP, LCP, and CLS are not just SEO metrics, but fundamental engineering constraints, and how to optimize them at the architectural level.
blog_posts.content:
### Introduction

Google's Core Web Vitals have fundamentally transformed how engineers assess website quality. Where legacy speed metrics simply counted DOMContentLoaded or overall payload weight, modern vitals measure user-centric perceived performance.

### 1. Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)

LCP measures when the main content of a page is likely loaded. To conquer LCP:
- Ensure critical hero imagery is preloaded with `<link rel="preload">`.
- Avoid client-side JavaScript rendering waterfalls for primary above-the-fold content.
- Serve compressed WebP/AVIF formats with explicit height and width attributes.

### 2. Interaction to Next Paint (INP)

Replacing First Input Delay, INP evaluates overall responsiveness across every page interaction. Long tasks exceeding 50ms block the main thread and degrade INP.
- Break up intensive calculation loops using `scheduler.yield()` or Web Workers.
- Debounce rapid scroll or input listeners.

### Conclusion

Treating web performance as a core feature rather than a post-launch afterthought guarantees both higher search visibility and superior conversion rates.

blog_posts.title: Architecting Clean WordPress Themes Without Page-Builder Bloat
blog_posts.excerpt: How modern PHP, modular Gutenberg blocks, and ACF Pro deliver an effortless editing experience with sub-second page loads.
blog_posts.content:
### The Problem with Visual Page Builders

Visual drag-and-drop builders are popular because they offer immediate visual feedback. However, the hidden cost is immense: tens of nested `<div>` wrappers, unminified inline styles, and hundreds of unnecessary database queries on every page render.

### The Modern Alternative: ACF Blocks

By leveraging Advanced Custom Fields Pro with native Gutenberg block templates, we achieve the best of both worlds:
- Content authors get an intuitive, visual block-editing UI.
- Developers maintain 100% control over semantic HTML output and clean CSS.
- Database queries are reduced by up to 80%.

### Best Practices for Enterprise WordPress

1. Use strict typing in PHP 8.2+.
2. Leverage transients and object caching for expensive database queries.
3. Sanitize inputs and escape all dynamic template outputs to prevent XSS.
